name: Pattern Machine D — Tile-Stamp Press
description: An interactive sci-fi printing press for wallpaper. The player arranges a small NxN stamp matrix on the angled press bed (touch-paint cells, pick ink, cycle group), pulls the press lever, and the head punches down and STAMPS the symmetry-tiled carpet onto a conveyor tray that feeds it off the front. Editable like pattern_maker_station, manufactured like pattern_loom — one apparatus does both. Reuses WallpaperGroups.get_symmetric_color for the live carpet and PatternSim.render_to_image for the proof sheet.
theoreticalGrounding: A print is a rule pressed into a surface. The matrix is the type, the wallpaper group is the forme, and the carpet is the impression. wallpaper_group is the critical parameter — one 3x3 arrangement of stamps, run through p1..p6m, prints 17 different universes.

pattern_machine_d.name: Pattern Machine D — Tile-Stamp Press
pattern_machine_d.description: A cast-iron press chassis with side cheeks, a crown beam, an angled editable stamp matrix, a press head on guide rods + a pull lever, ink-well palette buttons, GROUP / PRESS / CLEAR controls, a PatternSim proof sheet on the crown, and a conveyor tray that feeds the printed carpet off the front. Touch-paint the bed; output updates live; pull the press to punch + re-stamp. DNA: group (p1..p6m), palette, motif_seed, matrix_size, carpet/feed params.
pattern_machine_d.qfep_connection: F_order: the 17 wallpaper groups as a press program — a hand-set matrix multiplied by constraint into endless printed fabric.
